source.title: Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes Classification
source.editors: R. van der Laan and R. Fricke

Apogonidae.reason: Appendix 1 (p. 236): Kurtiformes new to the list, transferred from Perciformes following Thacker (2009) and McCraney et al. (2020). The catalog places it in Gobiiformes.

Cyematidae.reason: The 8th edition keeps Saccopharyngiformes; Appendix 1 records no change. The catalog includes these families in Anguilliformes.

Emmelichthyidae.reason: The 8th edition keeps this family in Perciformes. Appendix 1 (p. 243) moves only Acanthuridae, Chaetodontidae, Ephippidae, Lobotidae, Luvaridae, Pomacanthidae and Zanclidae to Acanthuriformes, following Gill & Leis (2019).

Esocidae.reason: The 8th edition keeps Esociformes; Appendix 1 records no change. The catalog includes pikes in Salmoniformes.

Eurypharyngidae.reason: The 8th edition keeps Saccopharyngiformes; Appendix 1 records no change. The catalog includes these families in Anguilliformes.

Gerreidae.reason: Appendix 1 (p. 246): Labriformes new to the list, Gerreidae transferred from Perciformes following Betancur-R. et al. (2017) and Dornburg & Near (2021). The catalog places it in Acanthuriformes.

Holocentridae.reason: Appendix 1 (p. 231): Holocentriformes new to the list, transferred from Beryciformes following Moore (1993) and Betancur-R. et al. (2017). The catalog keeps it in Beryciformes.

Polymixiidae.reason: Same order, spelled differently: the 8th edition prints POLYMIXIFORMES, the catalog Polymixiiformes.
